items.title: Example 5.24
items.prompt_text: Paul received $\$\text{50}$ for his birthday. He spent $\$\text{31}.\text{64}$ on a video game. How much of Paul’s birthday money was left?

items.title: Try It 5.47
items.prompt_text: Nicole earned $\$\text{35}$ for babysitting her cousins, then went to the bookstore and spent $\$\text{18}.\text{48}$ on books and coffee. How much of her babysitting money was left?

items.title: Try It 5.48
items.prompt_text: Amber bought a pair of shoes for $\$\text{24}.\text{75}$ and a purse for $\$\text{36}.\text{90} .$ The sales tax was $\$\text{4}.\text{32} .$ How much did Amber spend?

items.title: Example 5.25
items.prompt_text: Jessie put $8$ gallons of gas in her car. One gallon of gas costs $\$\text{3}.\text{529} .$ How much does Jessie owe for the gas? (Round the answer to the nearest cent.)

items.title: Try It 5.49
items.prompt_text: Hector put $13$ gallons of gas into his car. One gallon of gas costs $\$\text{3}.\text{175} .$ How much did Hector owe for the gas? Round to the nearest cent.

items.prompt_text: Christopher bought $5$ pizzas for the team. Each pizza cost $\$\text{9}.\text{75} .$ How much did all the pizzas cost?

items.title: Example 5.26
items.prompt_text: Four friends went out for dinner. They shared a large pizza and a pitcher of soda. The total cost of their dinner was $\$\text{31}.\text{76} .$ If they divide the cost equally, how much should each friend pay?

items.title: Try It 5.51
items.prompt_text: Six friends went out for dinner. The total cost of their dinner was $\$\text{92}.\text{82} .$ If they divide the bill equally, how much should each friend pay?

items.title: Try It 5.52
items.prompt_text: Chad worked $40$ hours last week and his paycheck was $\$\text{570} .$ How much does he earn per hour?

items.title: Example 5.27
items.prompt_text: Marla buys $6$ bananas that cost $\$\text{0}.\text{22}$ each and $4$ oranges that cost $\$\text{0}.\text{49}$ each. How much is the total cost of the fruit?

177 . Spending money Brenda got $\$\text{40}$ from the ATM. She spent $\$\text{15}.\text{11}$ on a pair of earrings. How much money did she have left?

179 . Shopping Adam bought a t-shirt for $\$\text{18}.\text{49}$ and a book for $\$\text{8}.\text{92}$ The sales tax was $\$\text{1}.\text{65} .$ How much did Adam spend?

183 . Diet Leo took part in a diet program. He weighed $190$ pounds at the start of the program. During the first week, he lost $4.3$ pounds. During the second week, he had lost $2.8$ pounds. The third week, he gained $0.7$ pounds. The fourth week, he lost $1.9$ pounds. What did Leo weigh at the end of the fourth week?

184 . Snowpack On April $1 ,$ the snowpack at the ski resort was $4$ meters deep, but the next few days were very warm. By April $5 ,$ the snow depth was $1.6$ meters less. On April $8 ,$ it snowed and added $2.1$ meters of snow. What was the total depth of the snow?

187 . Income Mayra earns $\$\text{9}.\text{25}$ per hour. Last week she worked $32$ hours. How much did she earn?
188 . Income Peter earns $\$\text{8}.\text{75}$ per hour. Last week he worked $19$ hours. How much did he earn?

191 . Restaurant Jeannette and her friends love to order mud pie at their favorite restaurant. They always share just one piece of pie among themselves. With tax and tip, the total cost is $\$\text{6}.\text{00} .$ How much does each girl pay if the total number sharing the mud pie is ⓐ $2 ?$ ⓑ $3 ?$ ⓒ $4 ?$ ⓓ $5 ?$ ⓔ $6 ?$

192 . Pizza Alex and his friends go out for pizza and video games once a week. They share the cost of a $\$\text{15}.\text{60}$ pizza equally. How much does each person pay if the total number sharing the pizza is ⓐ $2 ?$ ⓑ $3 ?$ ⓒ $4 ?$ ⓓ $5 ?$ ⓔ $6 ?$

193 . Fast Food At their favorite fast food restaurant, the Carlson family orders $4$ burgers that cost $\$\text{3}.\text{29}$ each and $2$ orders of fries at $\$\text{2}.\text{74}$ each. What is the total cost of the order?

194 . Home Goods Chelsea needs towels to take with her to college. She buys $2$ bath towels that cost $\$\text{9}.\text{99}$ each and $6$ washcloths that cost $\$\text{2}.\text{99}$ each. What is the total cost for the bath towels and washcloths?

195 . Zoo The Lewis and Chousmith families are planning to go to the zoo together. Adult tickets cost $\$\text{29}.\text{95}$ and children’s tickets cost $\$\text{19}.\text{95} .$ What will the total cost be for $4$ adults and $7$ children?

196 . Ice Skating Jasmine wants to have her birthday party at the local ice skating rink. It will cost $\$\text{8}.\text{25}$ per child and $\$\text{12}.\text{95}$ per adult. What will the total cost be for $12$ children and $3$ adults?

197 . Paycheck Annie has two jobs. She gets paid $\$\text{14}.\text{04}$ per hour for tutoring at City College and $\$\text{8}.\text{75}$ per hour at a coffee shop. Last week she tutored for $8$ hours and worked at the coffee shop for $15$ hours. ⓐ How much did she earn? ⓑ If she had worked all $23$ hours as a tutor instead of working both jobs, how much more would she have earned?

198 . Paycheck Jake has two jobs. He gets paid $\$\text{7}.\text{95}$ per hour at the college cafeteria and $\$\text{20}.\text{25}$ at the art gallery. Last week he worked $12$ hours at the cafeteria and $5$ hours at the art gallery. ⓐ How much did he earn? ⓑ If he had worked all $17$ hours at the art gallery instead of working both jobs, how much more would he have earned?

199 . At the 2010 winter Olympics, two skiers took the silver and bronze medals in the Men's Super-G ski event. Miller's time was $1$ minute $30.62$ seconds and Weibrecht's time was $1$ minute $30.65$ seconds. Find the difference in their times and then write the name of that decimal.
200 . Find the quotient of $0.12 \div 0.04$ and explain in words all the steps taken.
